results.title: Facebook, TikTok promoted Colombian armed groups' content to recruit children: NGO
results.description: Facebook and TikTok failed to prevent the spread of content produced by Colombian armed groups to recruit children and in some cases even "appeared to promote these posts," Human Rights Watch reported on Monday.
